currentGoal: Add a new Chill Philosopher class with a matching class portrait, chill/coolness theme, air-conditioning philosopher flavor, and follow-up visual polish from playtest feedback.
workCompleted: Generated a class portrait for Chill Philosopher using the user's reference image as loose style/character guidance.
Regenerated the portrait with light brown hair after user feedback, then processed it into a 128x128 transparent PNG at public/assets/ui/classes/chill-philosopher.png.
Added chill_philosopher to CharacterClassId and character class validation.
Added the Chill Philosopher class definition with icon loading, passive flavor, stat lines, and Air-Conditioned Detachment passive stats.
Added two class upgrades: Climate Control and Smug Syllogism, reusing existing weather-watching and better-eyes skill icons.
Added two class quests for buying Climate Control and maxing Smug Syllogism.
Updated class quest reward burst color and skill branch classification for the new class upgrades.
Increased class portrait badge sizes in TitleScene so the overview cards use the available space better, especially in the compact two-column picker.
Corrected board visual-size math so tile fields exclude a trailing gap after the final row/column; this centers the initial 1x1 grass patch inside its field frame.
